name: musket-fire-reload
description: Iron Musket firing and reloading (D-087, D-095): an empty musket refuses to fire; the reload key loads one Paper Cartridge from the backpack per 1.2 s stroke up to 5 and stops there (never above 5); each shot uses one, a bullet leaves the muzzle and flies far; a second shot within 0.8 s is refused; a shot stops a running reload and keeps what was loaded.
